detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Snap-8

Chemical Information:
  • Chemical Name: Acetyl Octapeptide-3
  • Molecular Formula: C₄₂H₇₂N₁₆O₁₅S
  • Molecular Weight: ~1075.3 g/mol
  • Sequence: Ac-Glu-Glu-Met-Gln-Arg-Arg-Ala-Asp-NH₂
  • Peptide Length: Octapeptide
  • Identifiers:
    • UNII: 8K14HJF88S
    • DSSTox ID: DTXSID70235943
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

Snap-8 is a synthetic octapeptide produced via solid-phase peptide synthesis. The compound is chemically designated as Acetyl Octapeptide-3 and is structurally defined by an acetylated N-terminus and an amidated C-terminus. It is supplied as a lyophilized powder for controlled laboratory use. This product is intended exclusively for in vitro analytical and mechanistic research applications conducted by qualified professionals and is not formulated for cosmetic, clinical, diagnostic, or therapeutic use.

Research Applications:
  • In-vitro evaluation of short synthetic peptide behavior in biochemical assay systems
  • Structural and stability analysis of acetylated peptide sequences
  • Laboratory investigation of peptide–protein interaction models
  • Analytical method development involving peptide-based research compounds
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at −20 °C until use
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2–8 °C and use promptly
  • Handle using appropriate aseptic laboratory techniques to preserve integrity
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white to off-white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory buffers
Compliance Notice:

Snap-8 is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
